workflowYaml:
workflow:
  id: idempotency-key
  version: 1
  parameters:
    tag: {schema: string}
  context:
    written:
      provider: script.effect
      version: 1
      with: {$ref: '$.parameters.tag'}
      idempotency-key: {$concat: ['tag-', {$ref: '$.parameters.tag'}]}
  outputs: [written]
